how_called: Header X-WP-Total on page 1 reports the record count (5964 at harvest time); X-WP-TotalPages reports 60.
Send a browser User-Agent and curl --compressed; without --compressed the HTML pages come back brotli/gzip-encoded.
This is the WordPress media library, i.e. EVERY PDF Permabond has ever uploaded, not only the ones currently linked from /safety-data-sheets/.

also_checked.https://www.permabond.com/safety-data-sh: public index page, 180 unique PDF links (all *_SDS_ES.pdf on the fetch we made)
also_checked.https://www.permabond.com/sds-americas-a: no PDF links in HTML - SDS delivery is gated behind Gravity Form id 7

notes: No filename in the media library contains the token ESP (case-insensitive). Permabond epoxy families present are ES5xx (one-part) and ET5xxx A/B (two-part).

Wayback CDX on permabond.com shows ESP104/ESP108/ESP109/ESP110/ESP308/ESP309/ESP311/ESP4028/ESP4072/ESP4138/ESP4582 literature URLs from 2003, but EVERY capture has statuscode 404, so no archived copy is retrievable.
